fields.reasoning: CI's budgets timing log shows the idle-poll median stepped from about 1.2-2.5 ms to 2.4-4.8 ms (6.0 ms in PR #567's failing attempt, 3% CPU pressure) exactly at PR #516's merge, while every read budget stayed far under 50 ms; the added cost is the forced catch-up the fixture's per-poll Evidence call now makes, which an idle driver never pays. Raising the budget would hide a real idle regression later; quarantining would drop TestReadBudget's whole read budget; weakening settle() would reopen the headless-run-agent-tabs race #516 fixed.
fields.statement: Fix the flake in the measure, not the product or the budget: driverPollBudget's idle measure times a poll without a verifier's Evidence judgment, because since PR #516 every Evidence read forces an index catch-up (settle) and the real driver judges Evidence only once, when a verifier session ends (judgeVerifier), never on an idle poll. idlePollCPUBudget stays 5 ms, unrelatedPollCPUBudget 50 ms, and #516's forced catch-up in stepRunner.Evidence stays as it is

fields.acceptance: Reproduce first: go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 1 -run '^TestReadBudget$' ./internal/api with RHIZA_BUDGET_LOG set to a scratch file, run 3 times one after another (never in parallel and never under generated CPU load, per AGENTS.md), recording each run's 'driver poll idle' median and CPU pressure in the Checks: block. Then in driverPollBudget the idle measure polls without judging Evidence (f.poll with no leaf), the warm-up polls and the 'after an unrelated entry' measure stay as they are, idlePollCPUBudget stays 5 ms and unrelatedPollCPUBudget 50 ms, the comment above the idle measure says why an idle poll judges no Evidence, and stepRunner.Evidence and settle() are unchanged. The same 3 runs then pass, each idle median recorded, their middle value lower than before on the same machine; go test -trimpath -count=1 -run '^(TestDriverPollIsCheap|TestEvidenceReadsPastSessionWrites)$' ./internal/api passes. Only internal/api/run_model_cache_test.go changes.
fields.statement: The driver CPU budget in TestReadBudget (driverPollBudget, internal/api/run_model_cache_test.go) times an idle poll as a real idle driver makes it, the leaves, answers and session status with no verifier Evidence judgment, so the forced catch-up Evidence makes when a verifier ends no longer pushes the idle median against its 5 ms budget
